author: GameSpot
description:
Swing in fast and keep your opponents guessing! 
In this Character Guide, we break down Spider-Man’s speed, web-powered mobility and close-range pressure so you can zip around the fight and turn every opening into damage.

Learn how to use Web Zip, wall movement, and web-shooter tools to bind enemies, and reposition quickly. 

MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026 PT!
